facts: EGT Spain markets Sheng Sheng Bu Xi as a persistence-math product for Spain.
The system has Bonus Boom and Bonus Craze.
Each title has three combinable Bonus Links.
Peanut indicators progressively open and are presented as signalling that one or more Bonus Links are approaching activation.
Bonus Craze persistent links: Extra Coins, Coin Collection, Extra Spins.
Bonus Boom persistent links: Multiplier, Double Matrix, Resurgent.
EGT Spain discusses volatility, Bonus Link access frequency and prize frequency as mathematical design variables.
The peanut mechanic is described as clearly showing increasing chances of entry into one or more Bonus Links.
Three combinable persistent Bonus Links per game.
As the fortune peanuts open, probabilities of accessing the Bonus Links increase.
Grand and Major are progressive; Minor and Mini are fixed.
The patent distinguishes perceived persistence, where the displayed state may have no bearing on triggering, from true persistence, where displayed state may represent trigger likelihood.
Therefore a marketing phrase such as perceived persistence must never by itself be treated as proof of conditional EV.
terminologyGuard.whyEgtNeedsSeparateProof: Spanish EGT descriptions independently state that chances increase as peanuts open, which is stronger than the generic perceived-persistence label, but the exact probability mapping and next-player scope remain unverified.

casinoBarcelonaEconomicHurdle.interpretation: An inherited observable state must add more than 5.47 percentage points of conditional expected return, after all jackpot/bonus accounting and under the exact state, for total conditional RTP to exceed 100%.

priorityProofProtocol: Observe a machine before inserting cash/TITO and record all peanut states for Bonus Boom and Bonus Craze; do not wager to manufacture a favorable state.

When a naturally occupied machine becomes vacant, record the displayed state immediately before and after the prior player's cashout/exit, only where observation is lawful and does not interfere with another player.
Verify whether the exact peanut state survives idle attract mode and remains for the next player without player-card/account continuity.
Repeat across multiple natural player transitions and at least two cabinets before classifying state as next-player inherited.
Determine whether selecting a different title or denomination changes/resets the three Bonus Link states.
Record state immediately before any naturally occurring Bonus Link activation to identify reset semantics.
Only after inheritance is proven, estimate P(bonus|state) prospectively and bonus EV by state; freeze bins before validation/holdout.
Require a conservative lower confidence bound on total conditional RTP above 100% before any execution candidate.
